blocks.text: Hyperquiz Wave 3 — Wire the Bind + Kill the Ghost Room

items: one ~2-line wire is the wave's whole leverage: bind_quiz/3 gets its FIRST production call site
honest states: a typo'd pin must say so — no more silent ghost rooms
finish line: hq-w1-live-verify closes 6/6 with live evidence, criteria upgraded honestly

content.value: Two slices, in order. (1) hq-quiz-bind-wiring (p2): Quiz.bind_quiz/3 has ZERO production call sites, so Studio live-edit silently no-ops for every hosted room — the charter Vision's core promise ("host live-edits a question mid-game and every connected screen updates in under a second") is dead code. Wire the ?quiz=<id> mount into QuizHostLive so a hosted room binds its quiz doc; after merge + auto-deploy, prove the round trip live on guerrilla: host a room bound to a scratch quiz doc, publish an edit in Studio, watch host+play update in under ~1s (w2 evidence triad), tear down with proof. This also un-parks hq-w1-live-verify criterion 2's stronger form — upgrade that stamp honestly. (2) hq-invalid-pin-ux (p3): today /quiz/play/<pin> lazily creates a room for ANY non-empty pin ('x', 50-char, URL-encoded script tags — all render a working player view), so a typo lands a player alone in a ghost room that looks real. Ship an honest, styled error/empty state; after deploy, run hq-w1-live-verify criterion 3 ('invalid pin shows a real error, console clean') and CLOSE the task 6/6 — its builder claim has likely lapsed; re-claim honestly.

PR #2816 (hq-w2-theme-reskin, Decision E) is OPEN with Elixir Test still running as this wave opens — the lead merges it and closes its task; wave 3 does NOT own it but MUST sequence around it (both slices may touch quiz.html.heex/LiveViews).
Open children this wave: hq-quiz-bind-wiring (p2, 0/2), hq-invalid-pin-ux (p3, 0/2), hq-w1-live-verify (in_progress, 5/6, claim likely lapsed).
NOT this wave: hq-heatmap-live-lever (p3, separate design), hq-orphan-branch-cleanup, hq-p7-* stay PARKED.

content.value: The finished experience: a host opens /quiz/host/<pin>?quiz=<doc-id> on the projector, phones join, and mid-game the host fixes a typo in Studio, hits publish — every screen updates before they look up. A player who fat-fingers the pin sees a calm, theme-token-styled "nobody is hosting this room" state — not a fake empty quiz. That closes the honesty loop the charter demands: no fake realtime, no fake rooms.

Tentative leans (Decide finalizes): (1) Bind wiring exactly as the task brief verified — extend QuizHostLive.mount/3 to accept "quiz" and call Quiz.bind_quiz(pin, qid) right after ensure_room; player LiveView untouched; guard the doc id against the known binary_id CastError footgun (raw junk id must NOT 500 the host page). (2) For invalid pins, lean option (b)+(c) combined: the PLAYER path never creates a room — it checks room existence without ensuring, and renders a soft honest state ("nobody is hosting this room yet") when absent; format validation alone (option a) cannot kill ghost rooms for well-formed typo pins, and join-only-if-hosted also closes a URL-scan resource-exhaustion hole for free. Host path keeps ensure_room. (3) Order matters: bind PR first (its live proof is the wave's headline), pin-UX second, both as own PRs through the Elixir Test gate (flake protocol Decision K, 2-rerun budget), both rebased over #2816 if it merges mid-wave. (4) Evidence bar is the w2 triad, verbatim: WS proof via curl handshake + onConnMessage cadence (chrome-devtools network panel never shows websockets — Decision I), scratch rooms/docs torn down with proof, no stamp over an unverified criterion.

Quality bar (Kinsta/Vercel): the invalid-pin state is a designed moment, not a plain

— it rides the derive(theme) token vocabulary the reskin just landed, matches the projector aesthetic, and keeps the console clean. The bind wire must be idempotent across host refresh/reconnect, and a bad ?quiz= id degrades gracefully (room still hosts, bind simply reports honestly).
14 Sonnet surveyors are flying now. Each question + why:

items: bind-seam-anatomy — What exactly do Quiz.bind_quiz/3 and Bridge.bind do (quiz.ex:51 →), and what happens on a nonexistent/malformed quiz id? Why: the mount wire's error handling and CastError guard depend on it.

quiz-doc-lifecycle — What schema is a quiz doc; exact bp/HTTP recipe to create, publish-edit, and delete a scratch quiz doc on guerrilla (incl. publish-wall tag requirements). Why: the live proof needs a scripted, tear-downable fixture.
host-mount-contract — QuizHostLive.mount today: params, error branches, behavior with ?quiz=<garbage>; binary_id CastError exposure. Why: the wire must not 500 the projector page.

player-join-path — Where the player path calls ensure_room; how to check room existence WITHOUT ensuring (Registry lookup?); race vs host; what self-reap does to connected players. Why: chooses between options a/b/c with facts.
error-state-precedent — The existing 'room is unavailable' branch + other honest empty states in the codebase: markup, classes, token usage. Why: the ghost-room fix should reuse, not invent.
reskin-interplay — PR #2816 diff: which token vocabulary lands in quiz.html.heex, merge status, conflict surface with both slices. Why: sequencing + the error state must ride the new tokens.

quiz-test-map — Where quiz tests live (bridge, LiveView mount), how to pin a mount-bind test and an invalid-pin test; studio-literal-check gate implications. Why: both PRs need protective tests, not vacuous green.

live-proof-recipe — Reconstruct the w2 verify triad as a runnable playbook (curl WS handshake, onConnMessage hook, isolated MCP session, teardown proof format) from the w2 paper/tasks. Why: wave-3's evidence bar is 'same triad'.

ledger-claims-state — hq-w1-live-verify: exact wording/stamps of all 6 criteria, claim state (lapsed?), correct re-claim + close sequence; hq-w2-theme-reskin close-on-merge ownership. Why: the wave ends in an honest 6/6 close, not a fabricated one.

abuse-surface — Does lazy player-side room creation allow unbounded room spawn by URL scan? What P6 anti-abuse/max_children limits exist? Why: if join-only-if-hosted closes a real hole, that strengthens the design case and its test.

Decide ran (Decisions M–S), both build slices flew and landed green, the review passed both clean with zero fixes, and PRs #2831/#2832 are filed. hq-w1-live-verify stalled honestly at 5/6 (Decision R gates it on merge+deploy). blocks.text: The wave's central premises all held under file:line evidence, and one premise of the strategic direction was REFUTED. Established: bind_quiz/3 (quiz.ex:50-53 → Bridge.bind/3) has zero production call sites, is idempotent (Map.put overwrite; MapSet-guarded subscribe), ALWAYS returns :ok, does an immediate synchronous load+apply at bind time, and degrades to a silent no-op on nonexistent, unpublished, or garbage quiz ids. Refuted: the binary_id CastError guard the direction called for does NOT apply to this chain — lookup is by doc_id, a plain string column (document.ex:13 vs :16; query.ex:730), never the binary_id PK. Builders must NOT add an Ecto.UUID.cast guard; it would wrongly reject valid non-UUID doc_ids.

items: Propagation is fully wired downstream of the missing bind: publish → post-commit broadcast on documents:<dataset> (broadcast.ex:53-99) → Bridge subscribes at bind time → apply_now → fresh uncached Repo.one → Room {:question_updated} on the room topic → QuizHostLive.handle_info already exists (quiz_host_live.ex:48-49). Sub-1s is structurally free. PUBLISH, never a bare patch, fires the event — the live proof must re-publish per edit.

Wire site: QuizHostLive.mount connected branch (quiz_host_live.ex:17-33); ?quiz= arrives in mount params on the plugin-declared :live route (plugins/quiz.ex:81-88, no handle_params). Refresh re-fires the connected mount, so re-bind-on-refresh is free and idempotent. Dataset arg defaults to "production" — must be a deliberate choice, not an accident.

Ghost-room mechanism: Room.ensure/1 (room.ex:99-112) spawns for ANY pin, reached by host mount (ensure_room), QuizPlayLive connected mount via Quiz.join (room.ex:132-136), and QuizChannel non-observer join. Room.whereis/1 (room.ex:88-95) is the proven zero-side-effect existence primitive (move/hover/call_existing already use it). Global cap 10_000 rooms exists (plugins/quiz.ex:69) but creation RATE is unthrottled; the player-side fix closes half the spawn surface for free, the host path stays open (flag to Decide as follow-up, not blocker).

Error state: reuse .q-status (3 precedents in the quiz LiveViews); after the #2816 reskin it inherits derive(theme) tokens with zero new CSS. Tone (quiet --ink-soft family vs danger tokens) is a Decide call — precedent argues quiet. quiz.html.heex IS scanned by studio-literal-check; no new hex literals.

Quiz docs are NOT publish-walled (@walled_types = paper, task — lifecycle.ex:58): the scratch fixture needs no tags/description. Teardown existence proof must use doc get, not doc ls (ls 404s on empty types). Exact bp doc create/publish/patch/delete bodies captured via --dry-run.

Test home: quiz_live_test.exs (async:false, unique pin, on_exit stop_room) for BOTH new tests; bridge_test.exs owns bind unit semantics. The mount-bind LiveView test and the connected-path invalid-pin test are genuinely new coverage. (One surveyor's 'no host-mount tests exist' was a too-narrow filename find — quiz_live_test.exs covers host mounts.)
Deploy: merge→live ≈4-5 min blue/green; live sha provable via authed GET /v1/capabilities?build=1 (.build.commit) — anonymous silently omits the build key.

Ledger: hq-w1-live-verify is 5/6, criteria 0-indexed; idx2 = park-satisfied Studio round trip (the upgrade target), idx3 = honest miss (invalid pin). Re-claim = same-worker targeted claim (renewal). hq-w2-theme-reskin's merge criterion is the LEAD's to close. Bind durability: bindings live only in Bridge memory with no unbind/GC (named slow leak, out of scope); a reaped room restarts on @default_question until the next publish/rebind — untested low-traffic staleness edge.

Elixir gate: the Decision-K flake is NOT fixed (task-13dacdcd75e1cabd open, unclaimed, p1) and hit 4 of the last 15 main runs; a SECOND uncharted flake (QueueTest queue_test.exs:385 Postgres plan-shape assert) hit 2 of 15 and is covered by no rerun protocol — Decide should file it.

N — Ghost rooms die at the JOIN PRIMITIVE, not the LiveView: whereis-gate the player AND observer channel joins ({:error,:no_room}); host mount stays the SOLE creator; quiet .q-status honest state (ink tone, NOT danger-red — three precedents); registry-count protective test, fail-before/pass-after.

O — queue_test.exs:385 is a permanent red, not a flake: Decision K's 2-rerun budget stays SupervisionIsolation-only; builders never burn reruns on 385 — state the exact failure set honestly in the PR body and hand the merge call to the lead (never cite the wrong flake id; #2816's body did).

Q — Honest-ledger correction appended to hq-w2-theme-reskin: its criterion-4 'Test green on rerun' claim is contradicted by CI logs (both attempts red on 385); the deliverable itself is genuinely merged+live.

items: one ~2-line wire is the wave's whole leverage: bind_quiz/3 gets its FIRST production call site
honest states: a typo'd pin must say so — no more silent ghost rooms
finish line: hq-w1-live-verify closes 6/6 with live evidence, criteria upgraded honestly

content.value: Two slices, in order. (1) hq-quiz-bind-wiring (p2): Quiz.bind_quiz/3 has ZERO production call sites, so Studio live-edit silently no-ops for every hosted room — the charter Vision's core promise ("host live-edits a question mid-game and every connected screen updates in under a second") is dead code. Wire the ?quiz=<id> mount into QuizHostLive so a hosted room binds its quiz doc; after merge + auto-deploy, prove the round trip live on guerrilla: host a room bound to a scratch quiz doc, publish an edit in Studio, watch host+play update in under ~1s (w2 evidence triad), tear down with proof. This also un-parks hq-w1-live-verify criterion 2's stronger form — upgrade that stamp honestly. (2) hq-invalid-pin-ux (p3): today /quiz/play/<pin> lazily creates a room for ANY non-empty pin ('x', 50-char, URL-encoded script tags — all render a working player view), so a typo lands a player alone in a ghost room that looks real. Ship an honest, styled error/empty state; after deploy, run hq-w1-live-verify criterion 3 ('invalid pin shows a real error, console clean') and CLOSE the task 6/6 — its builder claim has likely lapsed; re-claim honestly.

PR #2816 (hq-w2-theme-reskin, Decision E) is OPEN with Elixir Test still running as this wave opens — the lead merges it and closes its task; wave 3 does NOT own it but MUST sequence around it (both slices may touch quiz.html.heex/LiveViews).
Open children this wave: hq-quiz-bind-wiring (p2, 0/2), hq-invalid-pin-ux (p3, 0/2), hq-w1-live-verify (in_progress, 5/6, claim likely lapsed).
NOT this wave: hq-heatmap-live-lever (p3, separate design), hq-orphan-branch-cleanup, hq-p7-* stay PARKED.

content.value: The finished experience: a host opens /quiz/host/<pin>?quiz=<doc-id> on the projector, phones join, and mid-game the host fixes a typo in Studio, hits publish — every screen updates before they look up. A player who fat-fingers the pin sees a calm, theme-token-styled "nobody is hosting this room" state — not a fake empty quiz. That closes the honesty loop the charter demands: no fake realtime, no fake rooms.

Tentative leans (Decide finalizes): (1) Bind wiring exactly as the task brief verified — extend QuizHostLive.mount/3 to accept "quiz" and call Quiz.bind_quiz(pin, qid) right after ensure_room; player LiveView untouched; guard the doc id against the known binary_id CastError footgun (raw junk id must NOT 500 the host page). (2) For invalid pins, lean option (b)+(c) combined: the PLAYER path never creates a room — it checks room existence without ensuring, and renders a soft honest state ("nobody is hosting this room yet") when absent; format validation alone (option a) cannot kill ghost rooms for well-formed typo pins, and join-only-if-hosted also closes a URL-scan resource-exhaustion hole for free. Host path keeps ensure_room. (3) Order matters: bind PR first (its live proof is the wave's headline), pin-UX second, both as own PRs through the Elixir Test gate (flake protocol Decision K, 2-rerun budget), both rebased over #2816 if it merges mid-wave. (4) Evidence bar is the w2 triad, verbatim: WS proof via curl handshake + onConnMessage cadence (chrome-devtools network panel never shows websockets — Decision I), scratch rooms/docs torn down with proof, no stamp over an unverified criterion.

Quality bar (Kinsta/Vercel): the invalid-pin state is a designed moment, not a plain

— it rides the derive(theme) token vocabulary the reskin just landed, matches the projector aesthetic, and keeps the console clean. The bind wire must be idempotent across host refresh/reconnect, and a bad ?quiz= id degrades gracefully (room still hosts, bind simply reports honestly).
14 Sonnet surveyors are flying now. Each question + why:

items: bind-seam-anatomy — What exactly do Quiz.bind_quiz/3 and Bridge.bind do (quiz.ex:51 →), and what happens on a nonexistent/malformed quiz id? Why: the mount wire's error handling and CastError guard depend on it.

quiz-doc-lifecycle — What schema is a quiz doc; exact bp/HTTP recipe to create, publish-edit, and delete a scratch quiz doc on guerrilla (incl. publish-wall tag requirements). Why: the live proof needs a scripted, tear-downable fixture.
host-mount-contract — QuizHostLive.mount today: params, error branches, behavior with ?quiz=<garbage>; binary_id CastError exposure. Why: the wire must not 500 the projector page.

player-join-path — Where the player path calls ensure_room; how to check room existence WITHOUT ensuring (Registry lookup?); race vs host; what self-reap does to connected players. Why: chooses between options a/b/c with facts.
error-state-precedent — The existing 'room is unavailable' branch + other honest empty states in the codebase: markup, classes, token usage. Why: the ghost-room fix should reuse, not invent.
reskin-interplay — PR #2816 diff: which token vocabulary lands in quiz.html.heex, merge status, conflict surface with both slices. Why: sequencing + the error state must ride the new tokens.

quiz-test-map — Where quiz tests live (bridge, LiveView mount), how to pin a mount-bind test and an invalid-pin test; studio-literal-check gate implications. Why: both PRs need protective tests, not vacuous green.

live-proof-recipe — Reconstruct the w2 verify triad as a runnable playbook (curl WS handshake, onConnMessage hook, isolated MCP session, teardown proof format) from the w2 paper/tasks. Why: wave-3's evidence bar is 'same triad'.

— CORRECTION (2026-07-12, review): this callout was written at Digest and went stale. Decide ran (Decisions M–S), both build slices flew and landed green, the review passed both clean with zero fixes, and PRs #2831/#2832 are filed. hq-w1-live-verify stalled honestly at 5/6 (Decision R gates it on merge+deploy). Full story in the Debrief below.

blocks.text: The wave's central premises all held under file:line evidence, and one premise of the strategic direction was REFUTED. Established: bind_quiz/3 (quiz.ex:50-53 → Bridge.bind/3) has zero production call sites, is idempotent (Map.put overwrite; MapSet-guarded subscribe), ALWAYS returns :ok, does an immediate synchronous load+apply at bind time, and degrades to a silent no-op on nonexistent, unpublished, or garbage quiz ids. Refuted: the binary_id CastError guard the direction called for does NOT apply to this chain — lookup is by doc_id, a plain string column (document.ex:13 vs :16; query.ex:730), never the binary_id PK. Builders must NOT add an Ecto.UUID.cast guard; it would wrongly reject valid non-UUID doc_ids.

items: Propagation is fully wired downstream of the missing bind: publish → post-commit broadcast on documents:<dataset> (broadcast.ex:53-99) → Bridge subscribes at bind time → apply_now → fresh uncached Repo.one → Room {:question_updated} on the room topic → QuizHostLive.handle_info already exists (quiz_host_live.ex:48-49). Sub-1s is structurally free. PUBLISH, never a bare patch, fires the event — the live proof must re-publish per edit.

Wire site: QuizHostLive.mount connected branch (quiz_host_live.ex:17-33); ?quiz= arrives in mount params on the plugin-declared :live route (plugins/quiz.ex:81-88, no handle_params). Refresh re-fires the connected mount, so re-bind-on-refresh is free and idempotent. Dataset arg defaults to "production" — must be a deliberate choice, not an accident.

Ghost-room mechanism: Room.ensure/1 (room.ex:99-112) spawns for ANY pin, reached by host mount (ensure_room), QuizPlayLive connected mount via Quiz.join (room.ex:132-136), and QuizChannel non-observer join. Room.whereis/1 (room.ex:88-95) is the proven zero-side-effect existence primitive (move/hover/call_existing already use it). Global cap 10_000 rooms exists (plugins/quiz.ex:69) but creation RATE is unthrottled; the player-side fix closes half the spawn surface for free, the host path stays open (flag to Decide as follow-up, not blocker).

Error state: reuse .q-status (3 precedents in the quiz LiveViews); after the #2816 reskin it inherits derive(theme) tokens with zero new CSS. Tone (quiet --ink-soft family vs danger tokens) is a Decide call — precedent argues quiet. quiz.html.heex IS scanned by studio-literal-check; no new hex literals.

Quiz docs are NOT publish-walled (@walled_types = paper, task — lifecycle.ex:58): the scratch fixture needs no tags/description. Teardown existence proof must use doc get, not doc ls (ls 404s on empty types). Exact bp doc create/publish/patch/delete bodies captured via --dry-run.

Test home: quiz_live_test.exs (async:false, unique pin, on_exit stop_room) for BOTH new tests; bridge_test.exs owns bind unit semantics. The mount-bind LiveView test and the connected-path invalid-pin test are genuinely new coverage. (One surveyor's 'no host-mount tests exist' was a too-narrow filename find — quiz_live_test.exs covers host mounts.)
Deploy: merge→live ≈4-5 min blue/green; live sha provable via authed GET /v1/capabilities?build=1 (.build.commit) — anonymous silently omits the build key.

Ledger: hq-w1-live-verify is 5/6, criteria 0-indexed; idx2 = park-satisfied Studio round trip (the upgrade target), idx3 = honest miss (invalid pin). Re-claim = same-worker targeted claim (renewal). hq-w2-theme-reskin's merge criterion is the LEAD's to close. Bind durability: bindings live only in Bridge memory with no unbind/GC (named slow leak, out of scope); a reaped room restarts on @default_question until the next publish/rebind — untested low-traffic staleness edge.

Elixir gate: the Decision-K flake is NOT fixed (task-13dacdcd75e1cabd open, unclaimed, p1) and hit 4 of the last 15 main runs; a SECOND uncharted flake (QueueTest queue_test.exs:385 Postgres plan-shape assert) hit 2 of 15 and is covered by no rerun protocol — Decide should file it.

blocks.text: Decisions (M–S — charter is the memory, this is the story)

items: M — Bind wire exactly as verified; NO Ecto.UUID.cast guard (premise REFUTED: lookup rides the doc_id STRING column, never the binary_id PK — a guard would reject valid ids); dataset arg omitted (production IS guerrilla's dataset); no error branch (bind always returns :ok, idempotent across refresh).

N — Ghost rooms die at the JOIN PRIMITIVE, not the LiveView: whereis-gate the player AND observer channel joins ({:error,:no_room}); host mount stays the SOLE creator; quiet .q-status honest state (ink tone, NOT danger-red — three precedents); registry-count protective test, fail-before/pass-after.

O — queue_test.exs:385 is a permanent red, not a flake: Decision K's 2-rerun budget stays SupervisionIsolation-only; builders never burn reruns on 385 — state the exact failure set honestly in the PR body and hand the merge call to the lead (never cite the wrong flake id; #2816's body did).

P — The bind PR pays the Sobelow baseline debt: one .sobelow-skips line for quiz.html.heex XSS.Raw (bulldocs.html.heex:67 precedent); advisory gate, but the epic's own file carries no unexplained red.

Q — Honest-ledger correction appended to hq-w2-theme-reskin: its criterion-4 'Test green on rerun' claim is contradicted by CI logs (both attempts red on 385); the deliverable itself is genuinely merged+live.

R — Wave 3 FINISHES hq-w1-live-verify: after both deploys (poll authed /v1/capabilities?build=1 for the merge sha, ~4-5 min), live-prove the bind round trip (bp doc publish is the honest Studio-equivalent — identical broadcast; try Studio first, note which ran), upgrade idx2, prove idx3, re-claim honestly, close 6/6. Heatmap (idx4) stays parked; P7 stays parked.

S — Builder ground rules: worktrees branch from origin/main ONLY (local main = 98 noise commits ahead); teardown proof via authed curl, never bp doc get (false-404s for quiz unconditionally); bp doc patch takes the bare id; publish (not patch) fires the broadcast; WS proof stays curl-handshake (Decision I).
